items.body_raw: נִשְׁמָר
items.answer_raw: sing. masc. ptc. Niph. of שׁמר; it might also be the pausal form of 3 sing. masc. pf. Niph. (נִשְׁמַר)

items.body_raw: הִשָּׁפֵט
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. imperat. Niph. or cstr. inf. Niph. of שׁפט

items.body_raw: נִפְקַדְתֶּם
items.answer_raw: 2 plur. masc. pf. Niph. of פקד

items.body_raw: אֶשָּׁבֵר
items.answer_raw: 1 sing. impf. Niph. of שׁבר

items.body_raw: נִכְתְּבוּ
items.answer_raw: 3 plur. pf. Niph. of כתב

items.body_raw: נִשָּׁפְטָה
items.answer_raw: 1 plur. cohortative (§ 23. 1. 2) Niph. of שׁפט

items.body_raw: לְהִמָּלֵט
items.answer_raw: cstr. inf. Niph. of מלט, with the prepos. לְ

items.body_raw: יִשָּׁקֵל
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. impf. Niph. of שׁקל

items.body_raw: תִּלָּחֵם
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. or 3 sing. fem. impf. Niph. of לחם

items.body_raw: נִלְחַמְתִּי
items.answer_raw: 1 sing. pf. Niph. of לחם

items.body_raw: תִּזָּכַרְנָה
items.answer_raw: 2 or 3 plur. fem. impf. Niph. of זכר

items.body_raw: הָרְשָׁעִים לֹא יִכָּתְבוּ בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים
items.answer_raw: The wicked shall not be written in the book of the living.

items.body_raw: הַפַּח נִשְׁבָּר וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִמְלָטְנוּ
items.answer_raw: The snare is broken, and, as for us, we are escaped.

items.body_raw: וַתִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ חָמָס
items.answer_raw: And the earth was corrupted before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

items.body_raw: שֹׁפֵךְ דַּם הָאָדָם בָּאָדָם דָּמוֹ יִשָּׁפֵךְ
items.answer_raw: He that sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed.

items.body_raw: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַיִּגָּמַל
items.answer_raw: And the child grew and was weaned.

items.body_raw: נִגְרַשְׁתִּי הַיּוֹם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּמִפָּנֶיךָ אֶסָּתֵר
items.answer_raw: I have been driven out this day from the face of the ground, and from thy face shall I be hidden.

items.body_raw: וַיִּנָּחֶם יהוה כִּי עָשָׂה אֶת־הָאָדָם בָּאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh repented that he had made man on the earth.

items.body_raw: לֹא יִכָּרֵת עוֹד כָּל־בָּשָׂר מִמֵּי הַמַּבּוּל
items.answer_raw: Never again shall all flesh be cut off by the waters of the flood.

items.body_raw: בָּא הָאֹיֵב אֶל־הָעִיר וְלֹא יָכֹל לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ
items.answer_raw: The enemy came to the city, but he was not able to fight against it.

items.body_raw: ותשרף העיר באש
items.answer_raw: And the city was burned with fire.

items.body_raw: השמר לך פן־תכרת ברית ליושב הארץ ולקחת מבנותיו לבניך
items.answer_raw: Beware lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land and take of their daughters for thy sons.

items.body_raw: Yahweh is near to the broken of heart.
items.answer_raw: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵב

items.body_raw: I am hidden from the face of my God.
items.answer_raw: נִסְתַּרְתִּי מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהָי

items.body_raw: Hide thyself from his face.
items.answer_raw: הִסָּתֵר מִפָּנָיו

items.body_raw: Ye shall hide yourselves on that day.
items.answer_raw: תִּסָּתְרוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא

items.body_raw: And the earth was corrupted, and all flesh was cut off by the waters of the flood.
items.answer_raw: וַתִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ וַיִּכָּרֵת כָּל־בָּשָׂר מִמֵּי הַמַּבּוּל

items.body_raw: The arms of the wicked shall be broken.
items.answer_raw: זְרֹעוֹת הָרְשָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה

items.body_raw: Let me escape in the day of fighting (inf. cons.).
items.answer_raw: אִמָּלְטָה בְּיוֹם הִלָּחֵם

items.body_raw: And the earth was filled with blood (acc.).
items.answer_raw: וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ דָּמִים

items.body_raw: His dead was buried out of his sight.
items.answer_raw: נִקְבַּר מֵתוֹ מִלְּפָנָיו

items.body_raw: Thus saith (perf.) Yahweh the God of Israel: Behold I give (ptc.) this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape from his hand, but thou shalt be captured and given into his hand.
items.answer_raw: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי נֹתֵן אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל וְשָׂרְפָהּ בָּאֵשׁ וְאַתָּה לֹא תִמָּלֵט מִיָּדוֹ כִּי תִלָּכֵד וְנִתַּתָּ בְיָדוֹ

items.body_raw: Trust in Yahweh with all thy heart, and lean not unto (אֶל־) thine own understanding.
items.answer_raw: בְּטַח בַּיהוָה בְּכָל־לִבְּךָ וְאַל־תִּשָּׁעֵן אֶל־בִּינָתְךָ
